question: Gold-linked paper se modern fiat tak book kaun-se milestones deti hai?
essence: 1661, 1816, 1944 aur 1971 book ki selected milestones hain, complete history nahi.
answer: Book Sweden ke 1661 milestone ko 'First banknotes', Britain ke 1816 milestone ko Gold Standard, aur 1944 Bretton Woods ko dollar–gold link ke roop mein dikhati hai. 1971 modern fiat ka milestone hai: gold redemption nahi. [p004]
deep_dive: 1661 ka 'first' label universal first ke roop mein na padhein: isi page ki doosri timeline earlier Chinese receipts aur state notes bhi deti hai. Book is label ka precise geographical ya institutional scope nahi batati. [p004]
